Ruins.Name: Ruins
Ruins.Title: Survivalcraft Ruins · Mod settings
Ruins.Description: How often ruins appear, and how strong their guards are. Change any time; density only affects land you have not explored yet.

Density.Name: Structure density
Density.Description: Eight steps from off to maximum. Structures already in your world stay put.

Guards.Name: Guard strength
Guards.Description: Multiplies guard counts; 0 turns guards off. Takes effect at once, also at ruins you already found.
